Vessel.text: On your turn: You may place a card from your hand on the Altar facedown, then draw 1 card. This is not an Offer.
Vessel.why: The Offer reward is now always 1 Glory, so Vessel no longer copies it. Gaining 1 Glory measured 1.49; drawing a card measured 0.76 (V40 dealing)

Prophecy.text: In the Morning: Publicly declare a Target Alignment, Light or Dark. At the Reaping, if the Tide matches, gain 1 Glory; otherwise, including a Neutral Tide, lose 1 Glory.
Prophecy.why: Wording: the Day's phases are now Morning, Noon and Evening (was "During the Unveiling")

The Oracle.text: In the Morning, look at the top Event card. Play it, or bury it at the bottom of the deck.
The Oracle.why: Wording: Morning replaces the Unveiling; Morning comes once per Day, so "Once per Day" is dropped

The Whisper.text: In the Morning, publicly predict the direction of the Tide. At the Reaping, if correct, your Choir scores as if aligned with the Tide.

Creation.text: In the Morning, reveal 3 Host cards as Seed to the Altar instead of 1.

Equilibrium.text: In the Morning, move the Balance marker 1 space toward the center. No effect if it is already on the center space.

Casting Lots.text: Each player secretly predicts the Tide in the Morning: Light, Dark, or Neutral. At the Reaping, a correct call gains 1 Glory (2 for Neutral); a wrong call loses 1.

Babel.text: No table talk or deals this Day.
Babel.why: Glory is no longer given between players except by card abilities, so "Glory transfers" is dropped
